item.text:
Treat the decorative image as a visual counterweight, not content.

Place it relative to the flyer’s main text block—often aligned to a shared edge or compositional grid—then adjust it optically until the page feels balanced. Because decorative images can have uneven shapes or visual weight, strict geometric alignment may look wrong; a small offset is acceptable.

Keep it clear of essential text, preserve adequate margins and bleed, and verify the final alignment at actual print size.
